config.sqlTemplate: SELECT sum(latest) AS keys FROM (SELECT max(Value) AS latest FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'redis_db_keys' GROUP BY Attributes['db'])
SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, max(Value)) AS bytes FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'redis_memory_used_bytes'

SELECT round(100 * maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'redis_keyspace_hits_total') / greatest(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'redis_keyspace_hits_total') + maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'redis_keyspace_misses_total'), 1), 2) AS hit_pct FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('redis_keyspace_hits_total', 'redis_keyspace_misses_total')
SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, max(Value)) AS clients FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'redis_connected_clients'

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s, 2) AS commands_per_s FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'redis_commands_processed_total' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS series, max(Value) AS bytes FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('redis_memory_used_bytes', 'redis_memory_max_bytes') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(sum(Sum) / greatest(sum(Count), 1), 1) AS avg_us FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'redis_commands_latencies_usec' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS series, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) * 60 / $__interval_s, 0) AS per_minute FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('redis_evicted_keys_total', 'redis_expired_keys_total', 'redis_rejected_connections_total') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS series, round(max(Value), 2) AS value FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('redis_allocator_frag_ratio', 'redis_blocked_clients', 'redis_total_blocking_keys') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(avg(Value) / 1000, 2) AS latency_ms FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'redis_instantaneous_eventloop_duration_usec' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT MetricName AS metric, max(Value) AS value, max(TimeUnix) AS last_sample FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('redis_rdb_last_bgsave_status', 'redis_aof_last_write_status', 'redis_aof_enabled', 'redis_connected_slaves', 'redis_slowlog_length', 'redis_uptime_in_seconds') GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric

SELECT MetricName AS metric, round(max(Value), 3) AS value, max(TimeUnix) AS last_sample FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('redis_up', 'redis_exporter_last_scrape_error', 'redis_exporter_last_scrape_duration_seconds', 'up') GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric
